name: Apellica Insurer Denial Report Cards
description: In-network claim denial rates, internal-appeal overturn rates and external-review outcomes for 237 marketplace issuer-state pairs in 32 HealthCare.gov states, plan years 2024 and 2025 and 2026, derived without modification from the CMS Transparency in Coverage public use file.
citation: Apellica (2026). Insurer Denial Report Cards: in-network claim denial and appeal overturn rates reported by marketplace issuers to CMS, plan years 2024 and 2025 and 2026. v1.0, generated 2026-09-14. Derived from the CMS Transparency in Coverage PUF. CC-BY-4.0. https://apellica.com/insurer-denial-rates
spatialCoverage: Alaska, Alabama, Arkansas, Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Louisiana, Michigan, Missouri, Mississippi, Montana, North Carolina, North Dakota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Wisconsin, West Virginia, Wyoming

variableMeasured.name: in-network claim denial rate
variableMeasured.description: in-network claims denied / in-network claims received, as reported by the issuer

variableMeasured.name: internal appeal overturn rate
variableMeasured.description: internal appeals overturned / internal appeals filed

variableMeasured.name: external review overturn rate
variableMeasured.description: external reviews overturned / external reviews filed

measurementTechnique: Tabulation of issuer-reported counts from the CMS Transparency in Coverage PUF; stand-alone dental issuers removed; no estimation.
